item.title: The Call of the Wild
item.description: After losing his money, a prospector searches for gold with the help of his sled dog and a woman abandoned by her husband.

item.title: The Lion
item.description: A girl's attachment to a pet lion that she's raised causes conflict when her estranged father comes to visit Africa.

item.title: Rachel and the Stranger
item.description: A widowed farmer marries a servant, but the arrival of his old friend threatens his new life.

item.title: A Big Hand for the Little Lady
item.description: A pioneer woman replaces her ailing husband in a poker game after he loses most of their money.

item.title: Cowboy
item.description: An idealist hotel clerk joins a cowboy on an adventure to New Mexico, not realizing what it'll take.

item.title: 3:10 To Yuma
item.description: A mild-mannered cattle rancher takes on the task of conveying a captured outlaw to the train that will deliver him to prison. This mission turns into a nerve-racking, cat-and-mouse game that tests each man's particular brand of honor.

item.title: Bite the Bullet
item.description: Wild west saga of a 700 mile horse race across rugged terrain by nine men and women after big prize money.

item.title: The Grapes of Wrath
item.description: After losing their farm during the Great Depression, an Oklahoma family sets out on an arduous journey toward California, where they hope to find work.

item.title: Lifeboat
item.description: When their ship is sunk by a German U-Boat missile during WWII, eight survivors must overcome their differences in order to survive at sea.
